deadline_text_verbatim: Applications for all 2027 entry undergraduate courses, except those with a 15 October deadline, should arrive at UCAS by 18:00 (UK time) on 13 January 2027.
limitations: This is the UCAS-wide 'equal consideration' deadline, not a date this university sets on its own. UCAS's own wording excepts courses with a 15 October deadline (most medicine, veterinary medicine/science and dentistry). Whether a particular course at this university carries the earlier deadline was NOT verified per course in this pass; UCAS's course search states which deadline applies. UCAS also states: 'Universities and colleges do not have to consider applications received after the deadline, although they can if they have spaces available once the on-time applications have been considered.'

deadline_text_verbatim: Applications for any 2027 entry course at the universities of Oxford and Cambridge, or for most courses in medicine, veterinary medicine/science, and dentistry, should arrive at UCAS by 18:00 (UK time) today to guarantee equal consideration.
limitations: UCAS states this deadline applies to ANY 2027 entry course at Oxford and Cambridge — there is no January route to either university. The page's phrase 'by 18:00 (UK time) today' is the event page's own wording on its dated entry of 15 October 2026.

deadline_text_verbatim: Numerus fixus programmes: you can submit your enrolment application in Studielink until 23:59 on 15 January.
limitations: A national Studielink deadline that binds every Dutch university, not a date this university sets. It applies ONLY to that university's numerus fixus (capped, selective) programmes; which of this university's programmes are numerus fixus was NOT verified in this pass. Studielink states the date without a year because it recurs annually.

deadline_text_verbatim: Programmes without a numerus fixus: you can submit your enrolment application in Studielink until 23:59 on 1 May.
limitations: The national Studielink deadline for programmes that are not numerus fixus. Individual universities may set their own EARLIER deadline for non-EU/EEA applicants (visa and document processing); that per-university date was not verified in this pass and is not this row.
